facts.key: hey everyone as you all know the tlou 2 multiplayer mod that has been in development since january was supposed to release this month
facts.value: Hey everyone, as you all know, the The Last of Us 2 multiplayer mod that has been in development since January was supposed to release this month,
facts.context: "Hey everyone, as you all know, the The Last of Us 2 multiplayer mod that has been in development since January was supposed to release this month," Speclizer claims in a post on X.

facts.key: gone from a buggy 1v1 test to something that actually feels like a real multiplayer mode
facts.value: We've gone from a buggy 1v1 test to something that actually feels like a real multiplayer mode,
facts.context: "We've gone from a buggy 1v1 test to something that actually feels like a real multiplayer mode," the modder said in that video, touting newly added features like public matchmaking and a loadout system.

singleSourced.context: TLOU Online director Vinit Agarwal said earlier this year that the game was really good, which I suppose is what you'd expect him to say, and also that Naughty Dog had "developed it almost to 80% completion," which makes the disappointment of not getting it even more acute.

Monetisation might have been where Speclizer came a cropper, as the description of a TLOU 2 multiplayer mod showcase video they posted back in June touts being able to "gain early access to Starlight" via a Patreon page - which now only seems to host a "Notice" posted on September 6th.

With Sony stepping in to halt competitive multiplayer, however, it seems likely that any attempts to release a co-op mod would share a similar fate.
